stories.title: Council recommends approval for 109 affordable homes in Oakenholt
stories.summary: Planning officers are recommending approval for 109 affordable homes at Quarry Farm, Oakenholt. The scheme is a reduced resubmission of a previous application for 121 homes on the same site, which Flintshire’s planning committee refused in June 2025. Councillors refused the earlier scheme over concerns about over-development, high density, poor design and inadequate living conditions

stories.title: Even small increases in physical activity can make a big difference to your health, Chief Medical Officers say
stories.summary: The UK’s four Chief Medical Officers have issued updated physical activity guidelines, saying even small increases in movement bring significant health benefits. stories.title: Concerns over plans for firelighter storage warehouse metres from homes
stories.summary: Residents living just 50 metres from a proposed new storage facility for firelighters say they fear the plans will put their homes at risk. People living near Tiger Tim in Rhosesmor – the world’s largest manufacturer of firelighters – are asking Flintshire County Council’s Planning Committee to insist on stringent and clear fire safety measures
